architecture_summary: Modular React SPA. Pages in src/pages/. Shared components in src/components/. React Router v6 for navigation. Tailwind CSS for styling. No state management library (use React context for global state if needed).

tickets.title: Build Dashboard Home page (screen_1_dashboard_home)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React component. Extract reusable widgets (announcements, upcoming tasks, quick actions) into separate components. Use Tailwind for styling. Preserve all visual fidelity.

tickets.title: Build Homework Search page (screen_2_homework_search)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React component. Implement search functionality (client-side filter). Extract search bar and homework card components. Preserve all visual fidelity.
acceptance_criteria: Search filters work (subject, due date, status)

tickets.title: Build Calendar & Exams Schedule page (screen_3_calendar_exams_schedule)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React component. Implement calendar view (use react-big-calendar or native solution if simpler). Extract exam card component. Preserve all visual fidelity.
acceptance_criteria: Calendar displays current month by default

tickets.title: Build Transaction Detail page (detail_transaksi)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch HTML to React component. Extract transaction item component. Preserve all visual fidelity. Add back button functionality.
acceptance_criteria: Back button returns to previous page

tickets.title: Create shared layout components (Header, Sidebar, Footer)
tickets.description: Extract common layout elements from all screens. Build responsive header with user menu. Build collapsible sidebar with navigation. Build footer with copyright info.

tickets.title: Implement routing and app shell (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Set up React Router v6. Configure routes for all pages. Implement layout with header, sidebar, main content area. Add 404 page. Ensure navigation works between all screens.
